name: Grilled Miso Chicken & Mushrooms with Peanut-Broccoli Slaw
instructions: Place oil, miso paste, soy sauce, and pepper in a large bowl. Stir to combine the sauce.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the sauce.
Wash and dry mushrooms. Add to the bowl, then stir to coat the chicken and mushrooms.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add chicken and mushrooms. Grill, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and mushrooms are tender, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl along with broccoli slaw and peanut sauce. Stir to combine.
To serve, divide chicken, mushrooms, and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
